description: This file declares functions related to request object management in the server, including initialization, resetting, and freeing of request data structures, used within the server's request pooling logic.

methods.name: request_config_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default values for a request configuration structure.

methods.name: request_config_reset
methods.description: Resets a request structure to its initial state.

methods.name: request_init_data
methods.description: Initializes request data structures with connection and server context.

methods.name: request_reset
methods.description: Resets a request structure, potentially preparing it for reuse.

methods.name: request_reset_ex
methods.description: Extended reset for request structure, details depend on implementation.

methods.name: request_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with a request.

methods.name: request_acquire
methods.description: Obtains a reference to a request structure, increasing its reference count.

methods.name: request_free_data
methods.description: Frees data associated with a request.

methods.name: request_pool_free
methods.description: Frees the entire request pool resources.
